AgentTargetRef.description:
``{id, version, content_digest?}`` of an ``AgentTarget`` (ADR 0009 Decision 4, N35): what a
Run holds. What the run detects is recorded on the Run, never written back (P-23).
AgentTargetRef.title: AgentTargetRef

AppliesWhenCondition.description:
One typed condition of a price entry (P-37). A condition is something the resolver can
evaluate from the caller's ``PriceFacts`` or knows it cannot (``ambiguous_price``).
AppliesWhenCondition.title: AppliesWhenCondition

Artifact.description:
A stored file of a run, usually a recording (prefix ``art``; ADR 0012 Decision 4).

A record of fact. ``privacy`` is required on every artifact (ADR 0016 I3). The model hides its
input in validation errors, and no message quotes a rejected value (ADR 0007 Decision 8).
Artifact.title: Artifact

AudioFormat.description:
The format of an audio artifact (ADR 0012 Decision 4). ``container`` and ``codec`` are open
values; the numbers are strict positive integers.
AudioFormat.title: AudioFormat

BillingRules.description:
How a provider bills one event (ADR 0014 Decision 11, P-38): both parts are required and
each is a value or the literal ``"none"``. ``increment``: a positive decimal quantity in the
entry's unit (the quantity is rounded up to a multiple of it). ``minimum``: a USD ``Money``
>= 0, the minimum charge per billable event.
BillingRules.title: BillingRules

CallerExternalId.description:
The caller's transport identifier (a SIP or telephony ``user_id``, possibly a phone
number), verbatim, with its own privacy marker (P-43, ADR 0016 Decision 6). The only place
such an identifier may live; it never enters a snapshot.
CallerExternalId.title: CallerExternalId

ChannelAssignment.description:
One channel of a recording and whom it carries (P-31: ``mixed`` is a mono channel that
carries the caller and the agent together).
ChannelAssignment.title: ChannelAssignment

ChannelMap.description:
Which channel of an artifact carries whom (ADR 0012 Decision 5).

``declared``: the producer's documented layout (for example Pipecat's stereo buffer, left the
caller and right the agent); ``method`` names the declaration and there is no confidence (a
declaration is not a probability). ``inferred``: our analysis; ``method`` names it and
``confidence`` is required. At most one channel is the agent (a second AI agent is a separate
run), indexes are unique and the order is kept.
ChannelMap.title: ChannelMap

ConfigSnapshot.description:
The configuration a run used, frozen (prefix ``snap``; ADR 0006 Decision 1).

Checked on load, after the fields: the digest equals ``compute_snapshot_digest`` of the
document (``DigestMismatch``, ``DigestKeyUnavailable`` and ``UnknownDigestScheme`` unwrapped);
no definition and no binding is embedded twice (same ``id`` and ``version``; a code-only rule,
register row ``CO-LONG-LIST-UNIQUENESS``); the evaluator's persona and binding references,
and each binding's definition reference, resolve to an embedded record of that
``(id, version)``, and a digest on such a reference is verified (``RefDigestMismatchError``,
E5); every binding belongs to the evaluator; the rubric passes ``validate_rubric``; the
evaluator has at least one expected-outcome check, and every such check is a required rubric
item.
ConfigSnapshot.title: ConfigSnapshot

ConsentRecord.description:
Whether the person recorded consented (ADR 0016 Decision 3). ``unknown`` is a state, not a
default: it counts as not obtained for benchmark exports (P-44, P1-14).
ConsentRecord.title: ConsentRecord

ContentDigest.description:
``{scheme, value, key_ref?}`` (ADR 0006 Decision 3). An unregistered scheme raises
``UnknownDigestScheme`` (not wrapped by pydantic): it is never "unverifiable, accept".
ContentDigest.title: ContentDigest

CostExclusion.description:
A record a summary leaves out of its total, and why (Decision 16a): the record's
``na_reason``, ``duplicate_of_reported`` (an available computed record set aside for an
available reported one; ``covered_by`` non-empty) or ``overlaps_reported`` (an available
computed record that only partly overlaps included reported records, N53). ``covered_by``
lists the included records that cover all of the record's usage, else it is empty; it names
each record at most once (N78).
CostExclusion.title: CostExclusion

CostRecord.description:
A cost of one domain (prefix ``cst``; a record of fact; ADR 0014 Decisions 12 to 16).

``status=available``: an ``amount`` (USD, >= 0) and a ``basis``, with no ``na_reason``, no
``reported_raw`` and no ``unpriced_units``. ``basis=reported`` names ``reported_by`` and has no
``pricing_snapshot`` and no ``rounding``. ``basis=computed`` has the ``pricing_snapshot`` it
used, names no reporter, lists the usage records it priced, and carries ``rounding`` only when
the amount was rounded (P-35).

``status=not_available``: an ``na_reason`` and nothing that could read as a cost (no
``amount``, ``basis``, ``reported_by``, ``pricing_snapshot`` or ``rounding``; never an amount
of 0). ``reported_raw`` keeps a reported source's values verbatim and is present exactly for
the four reasons ``unsupported_currency``, ``currency_not_reported``, ``amount_unparseable``
and ``currency_conflict`` (N51). ``unpriced_units`` is non-empty exactly when the reason is
``unit_unpriced``. ``usage_record_ids`` has no repeats and follows the reason (N67): empty for
``no_usage`` and ``usage_not_reported``, non-empty for ``no_price_for_model``,
``unit_unpriced``, ``billing_rules_missing`` and ``ambiguous_price``.
CostRecord.title: CostRecord

CostRounding.description:
``{scale: 18, mode: half_even, exact: false}`` (P-35): present on an available computed
record iff the record's total was rounded.
CostRounding.title: CostRounding

CostSummary.description:
The cost of one domain of a run (prefix ``csum``; a record of fact; Decision 16). The
rules on the summary alone are checked here; the rules against its records are
``check_cost_summary``.
CostSummary.title: CostSummary

Dataset.description: A versioned set of dataset items (prefix ``dts``; ADR 0009 Decision 5, N25).
Dataset.title: Dataset

DatasetItem.description:
One item of a dataset (prefix ``dti``; a record of fact). It names no dataset: a Dataset
version lists its items (N25).

``language`` is the configured language of the item (intent, never an observation or a
declaration). ``artifact_id`` (a recording) and ``transcript_id`` are optional.
``source_run_id`` is provenance only, never run membership (O7). A ``privacy`` marker is
required when the item holds a recording or a transcript; with such a payload and no source
run there is no role evidence, so the item is treated as human-subject and a
``human_subject=false`` marker is rejected (ADR 0016 Decision 5). No mixed-language field
exists (ADR 0005).
DatasetItem.title: DatasetItem

DekWrap.description:
The payload's data key, wrapped with AES Key Wrap (RFC 3394) under the key-encryption key
that ``kek_ref`` names (ADR 0015 Decision 2). ``kek_ref`` names a key; it never holds one.
DekWrap.title: DekWrap

EnumScale.description: The options of an enum metric (non-empty, distinct ``MetricKey`` values).
EnumScale.title: EnumScale

EqualsTrueRule.description: ``equals_true``: a boolean passes iff it is ``true``.
EqualsTrueRule.title: EqualsTrueRule

Evaluator.description:
One test of an agent (prefix ``evl``; ADR 0010 Decision 8, ADR 0013 Decision 2).

``expected_tool_calls`` lists the tool calls the agent is expected to make; an empty list on
its own states no expectation. ``expected_tool_calls_exhaustive`` (F5-2) says whether calls
outside that list are allowed: ``null`` (the default) means not stated; ``true`` means a tool
call other than the expected ones is a failure, so with an empty list the agent must call
nothing; ``false`` means stated and not exhaustive (other calls are allowed). Only a JSON
boolean or ``null`` is accepted (no ``0``, ``1`` or ``"true"``). The flag is part of the
evaluator's content, so it is covered by ``content_digest``.

Its ``content_digest`` is computed over the generic digest domain minus the one path
``test_profile.content_digest`` (N20), so dropping or keying the profile digest in a shared
export leaves the evaluator's digest verifiable.
Evaluator.title: Evaluator

EvidenceRef.description:
A pointer from a result to its evidence in the same bundle (ADR 0012 Decision 3).

``ref_id`` is an ID of the kind ``kind`` names (``turn_``, ``exc_``, ``tcl_``, ``spn_``,
``art_``). Offsets are ``Ms`` from sample 0 of the artifact, with ``end_ms >= start_ms``.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

Exchange.description:
One request/response cycle of a run (prefix ``exc``; ADR 0011 Decision 4). Pipecat's
``turn_number`` maps to ``index``, never to ``Turn.seq``. ``was_interrupted`` is true, false or
unknown (``None``).
Exchange.title: Exchange

ExpectedToolCall.description: A tool call the agent is expected to make (ADR 0010 Decision 8).
ExpectedToolCall.title: ExpectedToolCall

ExternalRef.description:
An identifier assigned by another system, kept as data (never as our ID).

All three parts are stored exactly as given (ADR 0001 Decision 7).
ExternalRef.title: ExternalRef

IngestWarning.description:
Something an importer could not map faithfully (ADR 0012 Decision 7). ``path`` locates the
value in its source (the form depends on the mapping), ``raw`` is the source value verbatim.
A ``LanguageLabelWarning`` becomes an ``IngestWarning`` with the same ``code`` and ``raw``.
IngestWarning.title: IngestWarning

JudgeInfo.description:
The provenance of a judge's verdict (ADR 0010 Decision 6): the model asked for, the hash of
the prompt, the call parameters, the per-turn answers, and what the judge and the provider
reported. Nothing is synthesized: an absent ``confidence`` or ``p_yes`` stays absent.
JudgeInfo.title: JudgeInfo

JudgeTurnVerdict.description:
The judge's answer for one turn (``turn_seq`` names a ``Turn.seq``). ``p_yes`` is present
only if the judge produced it (ADR 0010 Decision 6).
JudgeTurnVerdict.title: JudgeTurnVerdict

KeyRef.description:
Names a key held by a key manager; never carries key material (ADR 0007 Decision 4).

``key_id`` is the key manager's own name for the key, an opaque string stored as given
(ADR 0001 I12), not one of our typed IDs.
KeyRef.title: KeyRef

LanguageDeclaration.description:
A user's declaration of the language of an untagged import (N14, ADR 0004 Decision 6g).

Never an observation: it fills no observed field, script-sensitive metrics never use it, and
every result that uses it says so (``language_source=declared``).

``language``, ``source`` and ``declared_at`` are required. ``declared_by`` (who declared it, a
machine key without ``@``) is optional (N19, ADR 0004 Decision 6g): ``None`` (absent and
``null`` are the same) says nothing about the declarer, and a present value is validated as
before. A shared or benchmark ``ExportBundle`` holds no ``declared_by`` (``[declared_by]``,
``bundle.check_export_bundle``); an internal export, a bare ``RunBundle`` and a bare
``Transcript`` may keep it.
LanguageDeclaration.title: LanguageDeclaration

MetadataFlag.description: A secret-looking string in ``metadata``: where it is and why (ADR 0007 Decision 5a).
MetadataFlag.title: MetadataFlag

MetricBinding.description:
A definition bound to an evaluator (prefix ``mbd``; ADR 0010 Decisions 4 and 4a).

``params`` set parameters the definition declares, stored unchanged; they never change a
definition field such as the pass rule (E6). ``check_binding_params`` checks them against the
definition. A disabled binding is never run and may not be a rubric item.
MetricBinding.title: MetricBinding

MetricDefinition.description:
What a metric measures and how it passes (prefix ``met``; ADR 0010 Decisions 1 and 1a).

The judge fields (``prompt_template``, ``prompt_variables``, ``judge_model_ref``) are required
for ``kind=llm_judge`` and forbidden otherwise; ``implementation_ref`` is the reverse. A
``scale`` belongs to rating and enum metrics, a ``unit`` to numeric ones. The pass rule fits
``value_type`` (for ``per_turn_share`` it is a range on the share and ``turn_rule`` fits the
type), its bounds lie in the value domain, and some value passes.
MetricDefinition.title: MetricDefinition

MetricParameter.description:
A parameter a binding may set (ADR 0010 Decision 4a). ``default`` of ``null`` means no
default; a present default has the declared ``value_type``.
MetricParameter.title: MetricParameter

MetricResult.title: MetricResult

ModelRef.description: A provider and model, without any key reference (ADR 0010 Decision 1a).
ModelRef.title: ModelRef

Money.description:
An exact amount of money: ``{amount, currency}``, both required (ADR 0014 Decision 1).

Equal by value. ``+`` adds exactly and returns the canonical amount; ``display()`` rounds for
presentation only.
Money.title: Money

OneOfRule.description: ``one_of{options}``: an enum value passes iff it is one of the distinct ``options``.
OneOfRule.title: OneOfRule

PayloadRedaction.description:
The redaction of the payload of one record of an export (S-N89, B3): ``subject_id`` (an
artifact, a transcript or a tool call) and the ``RedactionRecord``. Entries for one subject
add up (the union of their ``covers``).
PayloadRedaction.title: PayloadRedaction

PerTurnCounts.description: The per-turn outcomes of a ``per_turn_share`` metric (P-56); all four are required.
PerTurnCounts.title: PerTurnCounts

PerTurnShareAggregation.description:
The share of counted turns that pass ``turn_rule`` (P-58); its threshold is the
definition's ``pass_rule``.
PerTurnShareAggregation.title: PerTurnShareAggregation

PerTurnSummary.description:
The per-turn outcome of a ``per_turn_share`` metric (P-58): the counts, the turn coverage
(``counted_turns`` of ``total_turns``) and the share of counted turns that passed.

Checked on load: ``counted_turns = passed + failed``, ``total_turns`` is the sum of the four
counts (at least 1), and ``share`` equals ``metrics.per_turn_share(counts)``: present if and
only if a turn was counted.
PerTurnSummary.title: PerTurnSummary

Persona.description: The simulated caller (prefix ``per``): a configured language and an optional accent.
Persona.title: Persona

PriceEntry.description:
One price of a catalog version (ADR 0014 Decision 11; a value object since revision 15).

The entry lives inside its catalog version (N47) and is named by the author-assigned
``entry_key``, unique within that version (N61). ``price`` and the billing ``minimum`` are USD
money >= 0 (P-38); ``unit_quantity`` and the billing ``increment`` are positive canonical
decimals. ``billing`` is the literal ``"unknown"`` or billing rules whose two parts are each a
value or the literal ``"none"``. ``aliases`` are distinct and never the entry's own ``model``
(N72). ``applies_when`` is absent or a non-empty list of conditions of distinct kinds that must
all hold (N49). The effective range is half-open, ``[effective_from, effective_to)``.
``price_source`` says whether the price comes from the catalog or from the user, and a
``user_supplied`` price needs ``provenance.note``.
PriceEntry.title: PriceEntry

PriceProvenance.description:
Where a price came from (ADR 0014 Decision 11).

``kind`` is an open machine key. ``url`` is an absolute ``http`` or ``https`` URL of a public
price page (a fragment is allowed); it carries no credentials: userinfo, a credential parameter
name in the query or the fragment, a known credential pattern anywhere, and a loopback host
are rejected (ADR 0007 Decision 6e; N50, N66). A present ``note`` is never empty or white space
only (N71).
PriceProvenance.title: PriceProvenance

PricingCatalog.description:
A version of a pricing catalog (prefix ``pcat``; versioned, ADR 0009).

``entries`` is non-empty. Each ``entry_key`` appears once, and the effective ranges of entries
with one key ``(provider, model, unit, applies_when)`` (``applies_when`` compared as a set) do
not overlap; ranges are half-open ``[effective_from, effective_to)`` (N48, N49). Entries of
different keys that can match one usage are accepted; the price resolver answers
``ambiguous_price`` for them. The digest is the generic domain, so it covers every field of
every entry (D4).
PricingCatalog.title: PricingCatalog

PricingCatalogRef.description:
``{id, version, content_digest}`` of a pricing catalog (ADR 0006 I16, N26): the digest is
required, and ``check_pricing_catalog_ref`` verifies it against the catalog of the bundle.
PricingCatalogRef.title: PricingCatalogRef

PricingSnapshot.description:
The catalog version and the entries a computed cost used (ADR 0014 Decision 12, O6, N61):
``(catalog_id, version, content_digest)`` names one catalog version and ``entry_keys`` the
entries used, by their catalog-scoped ``entry_key`` (non-empty, distinct).
PricingSnapshot.title: PricingSnapshot

PrivacyMarker.description:
Whether a payload is human-subject data, with its consent and retention (ADR 0016).

Consent and retention are present if and only if ``human_subject`` is true (P-46): a consent
record for a synthetic voice would read as a consent gap. ``human_subject_reason`` records why
a marker is stricter than the derivation (P-47) and is rejected on a false marker.
PrivacyMarker.title: PrivacyMarker

ProvenanceRedaction.description:
The recorded omission of a provenance field of an exported dataset item (ADR 0016
Decision 9, O9, D2): the item, the field and the reason, never the run ID. Not a
``RedactionRecord``: it has no ``covers`` and never protects a payload.
ProvenanceRedaction.title: ProvenanceRedaction

RangeRule.description:
``range{min?, max?, inclusive}``: ``max`` alone means lower is better, ``min`` alone higher
is better, both a target band. ``inclusive`` applies to both bounds.
RangeRule.title: RangeRule

RatingScale.description: The integer scale of a rating metric (``min < max``).
RatingScale.title: RatingScale

RedactionRecord.description:
How a payload was redacted (ADR 0016 Decision 7): the ``method`` and the tool
(``tool_ref``) that performed it, when (``performed_at``, UTC), and the payload kinds it
``covers`` (a non-empty list of distinct members of ``REDACTION_COVERS``).

A value object of exactly four fields, with no id (S-N89). ``method`` and ``tool_ref`` are
non-empty free text for now (S-N86; P1-14 may narrow them). It holds no payload content, so it
does not hide its input (S-N88). The export rule that demands a seal or a redaction for
human-subject payloads is a bundle rule (P1-14).
RedactionRecord.title: RedactionRecord

ReportedCostRaw.description:
A reported source's cost values, verbatim and never parsed (ADR 0014 Decisions 12, 12b):
the amount lexeme, the currency label as sent (``payload``) or as the cited API contract
writes it (``api_contract``), or no currency (``none``). A present ``currency_raw`` is never
empty or ASCII white space only, which is no label (D6).
ReportedCostRaw.title: ReportedCostRaw

ResultError.description: Why a metric could not be computed although its inputs existed (ADR 0004 I3).
ResultError.title: ResultError

RetentionPolicy.description: How long human-subject data is kept, and whether it is deleted when the time is up.
RetentionPolicy.title: RetentionPolicy

Rubric.description: The checks of a verdict (prefix ``rub``; ADR 0013 Decision 7).
Rubric.title: Rubric

RubricItem.description: One check of a rubric: a binding, whether it is required, and an optional weight.
RubricItem.title: RubricItem

Run.description:
A run (prefix ``run``; a record of fact, ADR 0009 Decision 5).

It names the project, the agent target, and the configuration snapshot it ran with. ``mode``
and ``caller_origin`` are both required, and a ``simulated`` run never has a ``human`` caller.
``started_at`` is the start of the run and never the ingest time; absent when not known.
``caller_external_id`` is the caller's transport identifier with its own privacy marker.
``detected_capabilities`` (what the run detected) and ``available_inputs`` (what evidence it
holds) are separate lists. ``agent_audio`` in ``available_inputs`` needs a channel map that
identifies the agent's channel (ADR 0004 Decision 5). ``observed_tier`` is closed and required
and is for display and filtering only; ``spans`` in ``available_inputs`` with
``observed_tier=T0`` is rejected, because stage spans come only from agent telemetry or an
observer (rule R1, O3a; ``detected_capabilities`` is not read for it).
Run.title: Run

RunBundle.description:
The records of one run (prefix ``rbnd``; N22, B1). A record of fact.

``run`` and ``snapshot`` are required; every list defaults to empty and ``verdict`` to none.
``withheld`` declares the records the bundle deliberately does not carry. No sealed payload,
no redaction and no purpose: those belong to the ``ExportBundle`` (ADR 0015 Decision 7, B9).
``check_run_bundle`` runs on load, after the fields.
RunBundle.title: RunBundle

RunVerdict.description:
The verdict of a run (prefix ``vrd``; ADR 0013). A record of fact without ``run_id``: the
RunBundle is the unit of a run (N22).
RunVerdict.title: RunVerdict

ScorerInfo.description:
The non-judge scorer that ran (P-61): ``implementation_ref`` equals the definition's, and
``version`` is stored verbatim and compared for equality only (never parsed or ordered).
ScorerInfo.title: ScorerInfo

ScriptedTurn.description: A scripted caller line: its list position, its text and its language.
ScriptedTurn.title: ScriptedTurn

SealedAadFields.description:
The additional authenticated data of a sealed payload (ADR 0015 Decision 4).

Decryption under any other ``payload_type``, ``subject_id``, ``subject_version`` or
``schema_version`` fails authentication. ``schema_version`` is the plaintext's version and is
not compared with the package's version (S-N79): a migrated bundle does not rewrite it.
SealedAadFields.title: SealedAadFields

SealedPayload.description:
An encrypted payload bound to its subject (ADR 0015 Decision 1). Only an ``ExportBundle``
may carry one (Decision 7, P1-14); snapshots, runs and internal bundles never do.
SealedPayload.title: SealedPayload

Segment.description:
A part of a turn with its own timing (P-28): a word, a phrase (a Sarvam phrase timestamp)
or an utterance. The text is stored verbatim and its bidi flag is computed when omitted and
verified when supplied (ADR 0017 Decision 2).
Segment.title: Segment

StageSpan.description:
The timing of one pipeline stage (prefix ``spn``; ADR 0012 Decision 2).

``stage_raw`` keeps the source's label when, and only when, ``stage`` is ``other`` (P-05).
Values the source does not give stay absent and are never derived. ``span_ref`` points to the
raw span or trace (a foreign identifier, ADR 0012 Decision 6).
StageSpan.title: StageSpan

TestProfile.description: The identity a simulated caller presents (prefix ``tpf``). Every data field is PII.
TestProfile.title: TestProfile

TestProfileRef.description: ``{id, version, content_digest?}`` of a ``TestProfile``; it holds no profile value.
TestProfileRef.title: TestProfileRef

TimelineOrigin.description:
What offset 0 means (ADR 0002 Decision 3): sample 0 of an artifact (``kind=artifact``,
``ref`` an ``art_`` ID), or the start of a telemetry trace or an observer session (``ref`` an
``ExternalRef`` of the source, or none).
TimelineOrigin.title: TimelineOrigin

ToolCallEvent.description:
A tool call of the agent (prefix ``tcl``; ADR 0012 Decision 1).

``arguments_complete`` is required and never inferred. ``result_complete`` needs
``result_raw``. ``timeline_origin`` is present if and only if ``offset_ms`` is. ``seq`` is the
order of the calls of a run and is unique there (``check_tool_call_seqs``). ``result_error``
is true, false or unknown (``None``): ``status`` says only whether the call finished. The
event carries no privacy marker of its own (it takes its run's derived value).
ToolCallEvent.title: ToolCallEvent

Transcript.description:
A transcript of a run (prefix ``tsc``; ADR 0011 Decision 1).

``source`` names the producer, while each turn's ``source`` names its pipeline stage.
``declared_language`` is allowed only on an imported transcript (``agent_export``,
``agent_telemetry``, ``observer``, ``human_reference``) that carries no language label
(``detected_language`` and ``detected_language_raw`` both absent); it is never copied into an
observed field. ``provider_call_ref`` is the provider's request identifier (N28).
Transcript.title: Transcript

Turn.description:
One turn of a transcript (prefix ``turn``; ADR 0011 Decisions 1 to 3).

``seq`` orders the turns of its transcript and is unique there (``check_transcript``).
Timing is optional: ``timing_source`` is ``none`` if and only if the turn has neither
``start_ms`` nor ``end_ms`` (a ``wall_time`` is not an offset). ``end_ms >= start_ms``, and a
segment's bounds lie inside the turn's. ``language`` is any well-formed observed tag and
``language_raw`` the provider's label, verbatim. ``interrupted`` is true, false or unknown
(``None``). There is no confidence on a turn (P-29).
Turn.title: Turn

UsageQuantity.description:
One usage bucket of a billable call (ADR 0014 Decision 9).

``unit`` is one of eight disjoint buckets (``input_tokens`` is uncached input). For the token,
character and request units ``count`` is a strict integer >= 0; for the two audio-seconds
units (``audio_input_seconds``, ``audio_output_seconds``) it is a canonical decimal string
>= 0 (a JSON number is rejected, so seconds are never a float). Zero is known usage of nothing
(N45 (b)); no quantity is negative (N45 (a)).
UsageQuantity.title: UsageQuantity

UsageRecord.description:
The usage of one billable call (prefix ``use``; a record of fact, ADR 0009 Decision 5).

``run_id`` names the run (the only record of fact that does, N22). ``model`` absent or
``null`` means the source did not report a model: a placeholder such as ``"unknown"`` is never
stored as a model, and a usage without a model is never priced (M3). ``occurred_at`` is the
instant of the billable event as the source states it, never filled with the ingest time, the
run start or the current time (N43). ``quantities`` is non-empty with at most one quantity per
unit; the units are disjoint and never summed (N44). ``raw`` is the source payload, an I-JSON
object kept verbatim and never interpreted. Usage of the ``agent_under_test`` domain is never
``source=measured`` (P-39): we never make the agent's billable calls. A correction is a new
record with a new ID.
UsageRecord.title: UsageRecord

VerdictCheck.description:
One required rubric binding and the outcome of its result (ADR 0013 Decisions 2 and 3).
``metric_ref`` is the binding's ``metric`` reference, never text.
VerdictCheck.title: VerdictCheck

WallTime.description: A wall-clock instant and what it marks (ADR 0002 Decision 4). Never an offset.
WallTime.title: WallTime

WeightedExclusion.description: A weighted check left out of the weighted score, and why (ADR 0013 Decision 8).
WeightedExclusion.title: WeightedExclusion

WithheldRecord.description:
A record that a run bundle deliberately does not carry (ADR 0004 Decision 2a, D3, B4):
the record's ``kind`` (``WITHHOLDABLE_KINDS``) and its ``record_id``, a typed ID of that kind.
It names a kind and an ID, never a value.
WithheldRecord.title: WithheldRecord

description:
An export of run bundles and datasets (prefix ``exp``; ADR 0016 Decision 7, B1). A record
of fact. ``purpose`` is ``internal``, ``shared_export`` or ``benchmark``. The only entity that
embeds sealed payloads (ADR 0015 Decision 7). ``check_export_bundle`` runs on load, after the
fields (and after each embedded run bundle has passed ``check_run_bundle``).
title: ExportBundle
